annotations.title: Route me to the right paid API

description: Say what you need in plain words (e.g. "bitcoin price", "web search", "screenshot a URL"). Returns the one paid API that buyers actually pay for (distinct buyers in 30 days) and that answered a valid x402 402 to our check seconds ago, the exact request to send, and that seller's payment terms so you can pay on your first request; up to four alternatives. Free, no key. Same as GET https://bazaar.agentexchange.work/route.json?need= . Also covers x402scan and AgentCash listings (beyond the CDP and PayAI catalogs), each probed live: https://store.agentexchange.work/find/preview?need=<words>.

max_price_usd.description: optional: only routes at or below this price
